name: universal-profiles-tokens
description: Universal Profiles design tokens. Primitive values are the LUKSO base layer plus the Universal Profiles product layer; semantic tokens resolve per theme; component tokens reference semantic or primitive tokens only.

statusVocabulary.observed: Value read from current production code, approved collateral or a cited design file, unchanged.
statusVocabulary.normalized: Derived from observed values by reconciling, rounding, renaming, or extending an existing scale; the derivation is recorded in the token note.
statusVocabulary.proposed: New value or structure introduced by this design system; not yet in production and not formally approved.
statusVocabulary.obsolete: Exists in production or older collateral but must not be used in new work; kept only so migrations can map from it.
statusVocabulary.open: Placeholder value awaiting an owner decision or missing evidence; the value itself is not evidence-backed and carries an OPEN item.

extensionFields.source: Source key from provenance/sources.json, optionally followed by a colon and a locator inside that source
extensionFields.open: Optional OPEN-nn identifier from provenance/open-items.md when a later audit may change the value
extensionFields.note: Free text: derivation, usage limits, contrast results
extensionFields.deprecated: Optional true when the token exists only for migration

inheritance: A group-level $extensions.up object supplies defaults for every token beneath it; a token-level object overrides individual fields.
